---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a script error, macOS compatibility issue, or broken UI/service behavior
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: bug
---

**Describe the issue**
A clear and concise description of what happened.

**Environment**
- macOS Version (`sw_vers`): e.g. macOS 27.2.1 (26B131)
- Chip (`sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string`): e.g. Apple M2 Pro
- SIP Status (`csrutil status`): Enabled / Disabled

**Script / Audit Output**
Paste any relevant terminal output (please redact personal usernames or paths if needed).
